references.text: The Lord commanded Moses to go up on Mount Abarim to see the land, and told him that he would be gathered to his people, just as this command in Deuteronomy 32:48
The expression 'on this very day' (בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה) is also used here, pointing to a specific and significant day in God's actions
The same expression 'on this very day' is used regarding the circumcision of Abraham and his household, marking important moments in covenant history
The expression 'on this very day' is used concerning Israel's departure from Egypt, linking Moses' final command to the beginning of the people
The fulfillment of the command given in 32:48-52, where Moses goes up on Mount Nebo and dies after seeing the promised land
The background for why Moses was not allowed to enter the land - he did not honor the Lord at the waters of Meribah
